_README: Per-model Anthropic pricing in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Editable; surfaced read-only in Settings. Cost = (input_tokens/1e6 * input) + (output_tokens/1e6 * output). cache_write/cache_read optional; fall back to input/output if a call doesn't report them. Update when Anthropic pricing changes.
_note: Verify these rates against current Anthropic pricing before trusting cost figures. Unknown model IDs fall back to default_model and are flagged on the cost page.
